purpose: Audited queue for replacing weak project-generated product references with GPT Image 2.0+ studio packshots after clean product parsing.
quality_gate: clean-parse the target product from reliable public product pages before generation
one product only on pure white studio background
preserve product type, silhouette, materials, construction cues, color family and visible branding implied by the exact product name
no model, hands, props, packaging, UI chrome, text overlays, watermarks, vector art or illustration
keep the complete product inside frame except for explicit material-detail views
manager must still verify exact SKU, color, size, tags, packaging and availability before payment
